title: Everest vs Mauna Kea vs Olympus Mons | Mountain Size Comparison #shorts
description_hook: From Everest to a volcano on Mars about 22 km high: the tallest mountains in the solar system, measured different ways.

items.name: MOUNT EVEREST
items.label: 8.8 KM
items.say: How tall do mountains get in space? Measured different ways, but start with Everest: 8,848 meters.
items.img: a towering snow-covered Himalayan summit at dawn with a long plume of wind-blown snow streaming off its sharp peak

items.name: MAUNA KEA (FULL)
items.label: 10.2 KM
items.say: Mauna Kea, from the seafloor: more than 10,210 meters.
items.img: a broad volcanic mountain rising out of a dark blue ocean, half its slope visible underwater in a split above-and-below view

items.name: MAXWELL MONTES
items.label: 11.5 KM
items.img: a jagged mountain range under a thick yellow-orange cloud ceiling on a scorching rocky planet, heat shimmer over the plains

items.name: VESTA PEAK
items.label: 15 KM
items.say: A peak on the asteroid Vesta: about 15 kilometers.
items.img: a lone central mountain rising from the floor of an enormous crater on a small grey asteroid, black starry sky, harsh sunlight

items.name: OLYMPUS MONS
items.label: 22 KM
items.say: Olympus Mons on Mars, the largest volcano in the solar system: about 22 kilometers.
items.img: a gigantic gently sloping shield volcano on a rusty red plain with a wide collapsed caldera at its top, thin pink sky

items.name: OLYMPUS MONS' BASE
items.say: But height isn't the scary part. Its base covers an area as large as Arizona.
items.img: an orbital view of a colossal red volcano whose base spreads out like a continent, cliffs ringing its edge, curved planet horizon

gumi.say: Gumi's verdict: Everest is a hill with good marketing. Which one would you climb?
